newsitem.title: TURKEY: Two Turkish soldiers, four rebels dead in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Two Turkish soldiers, four rebels dead in clashes.

text.p: Two Turkish soldiers were killed in fighting with Kurdish rebels in a mountainous eastern province, military sources said on Friday.
Two other soldiers were wounded in Thursday evening's clash with Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas at a village in Tunceli province. There was no information on rebel casualties.
The fighting followed an attack by four Turkish planes on rebel positions in another part of Tunceli on Thursday. The sources said air attacks continued on Friday.
Four PKK rebels were killed in separate clashes with state-sponsored village guards in the southeastern province of Sirnak on Thursday night, Anatolian news agency said.
More than 26,000 people have died since 1984 in an armed conflict between the military and the PKK, fighting for self-rule in southeast Turkey.
